fixes.fix: Explained "What do you know about Ferdinand II (9 July 1578 – 15 February 1637)?"
fixes.text: VERDICT: Ferdinand II was Holy Roman Emperor and King of Bohemia, Hungary, and Croatia from 1619 to 1637. WHY: He was the son of Archduke Charles II of Inner Austria and Maria of Bavaria, both devout Catholics, which shaped his religious policies. TRAPS: Do not confuse his reign start (1619) with his birth (1578) or his death (1637). HOOK: Remember the '1619-1637' window as the peak of the Thirty Years' War era, where his Catholic stance defined imperial policy.

fixes.fix: Explained "Ferdinand II (9 July _____ – 15 February 1637) was Holy Roman Emperor, King of Bohemia, Hu"
fixes.text: VERDICT: 1578. WHY: Ferdinand II was born on 9 July 1578, beginning a life that culminated in his 1619 election as Holy Roman Emperor. TRAPS: Confusing his birth year with his accession year (1619) or his death year (1637) is the primary error here. HOOK: Remember '78-19-37' as his birth, reign start, and death. Exam trap: Do not mix him with his father, Ferdinand I, or other Habsburgs; focus strictly on the 1619 accession date.

fixes.fix: Explained "He was the son of _____ of Inner Austria and Maria of Bavaria, who were devout Catholics"
fixes.text: 1) VERDICT: Archduke Charles II. 2) WHY: He was the son of Archduke Charles II of Inner Austria and Maria of Bavaria, both devout Catholics. 3) TRAPS: Confusing 'Inner Austria' with Outer Austria or misattributing the Bavarian lineage. 4) HOOK: Remember 'Inner Austria' links to Charles II; 'Bavaria' links to Maria. Exam trap: Do not confuse this Charles II with other Habsburg archdukes of the same era.
